title: وضوح الفرع والإغلاق الآمن
rule:
Applies when: When work uses Git.
Report the observed working branch at start, material switches and handoff; disclose relevant unmerged work and remote freshness. Pursue safe review, merge, synchronization and return to the actual default branch only when ready and authorized. Preserve unrelated branches/worktrees and never infer squash-merge status from ancestry alone.
rationale: عمليات Git دون حالة وتفويض واضحين قد تفقد عملاً أو تدمج خطأ. PROVISIONAL_OWNER_REVIEW
reviewCadence: Owner review before activation and after material changes
